ledger.purpose: Write-as-you-go OK/ERROR ledger for the five-layer security audit. Each key is written when its layer completes, so a layer that never ran leaves its key ABSENT instead of looking successful. A missing status is a FAILURE under verification check 15, never an implicit OK, and is never backfilled with a guess.
ledger.key_equivalence_note: The four *_status keys are the pre-agent set check 15 names verbatim; the six short-form keys are exactly findings-merged.json _summary.layer_status, so the merge populates all six from here with zero drift and invents nothing. Equivalent keys always carry the same value. layer_1 and layer_3b have no *_status form because check 15's *_status set covers the pre-agent layers only.
ledger.absent_key_semantics: A key absent here means that layer recorded no status; check 15 reads that as FAILURE, not as success.
ledger.write_discipline: Ordered and evidence-gated: each key was written only after that layer's criterion was re-verified against that layer's own artifacts, and this file was re-emitted after every step, so its content is the accumulated end state of those writes, and a consumer can therefore tell a layer that succeeded from a layer that never ran.
ledger.gate_contract: Any ERROR here fires the gate's ERROR branch, which outranks BLOCK, WARN and PASS in strict precedence. A layer documented ERROR here may legitimately lack its normalized findings artifact (checks 3 and 10) and contributes zero to the merged summary's expected counts (check 11).
ledger.error_reason_convention: An ERROR is always accompanied by an error_reason on its layer record and a specific reason in run-metadata.txt. A status is never left unexplained.

evidence.pack_rules_loaded_note: 725 of 837 authored stanzas load after cross-pack de-duplication and language filtering

syntax_scan_completeness.verdict_basis: Every affected file was allowlisted into one of the three notice classes; each class was re-scanned with a compatible parser and recovered zero findings, leaving no file unaccounted for. All notices are non-fatal and the invocation reported executionSuccessful.
syntax_scan_completeness.verdict_derivation: security-audit/run-metadata.txt, affected-file allowlist and secondary-coverage section
syntax_scan_completeness.consumer_note: Every findings-layer-2-semgrep.json record carries file_parse_complete, so consumers can filter by whether a finding's file parsed in full.

3a.name: Sink and mitigation inventory
3a.criterion: all four inventories exist, both primary inventories are non-empty, all 19 sink and all 9 mitigation categories are covered, and every line matches the mandated format

evidence.test_partition_note: Verification check 6 requires only that the two test inventories exist. The 19-sink and 9-mitigation coverage obligation is asserted over the primary partition, so a category unrepresented in a test partition is not a defect.

4.criterion: the result document was produced and parses - never the process exit code

evidence.exit_code_note: osv-scanner exits 1 when it finds vulnerabilities - the expected outcome - so the exit code is deliberately not the signal.

provenance.audited_source_revision_note: The codebase state every layer measured. Deliberately not the current branch tip, which advances with each artifact commit and is never a measurement basis.
provenance.run_id_basis: sha256 over the newline-terminated listing of every attested output as "<relative path> <sha256>", one per line, sorted by path, then hex-encoded. Reproduce it by rebuilding that listing from attested_outputs and hashing it; it is content-derived, so it is identical for identical outputs and changes the moment any attested byte changes.
provenance.attested_scope: The seventeen upstream artifacts whose existence and content these statuses assert. Deliberately excluded: layer-status.json itself (a file cannot carry its own digest), baseline.json and findings-merged.json (downstream consumers of this ledger - binding them here would invert the dependency direction), and run-metadata.txt (provenance narrative, not a layer output).
provenance.consumer_contract: A consumer MUST re-measure every attested output and compare bytes and sha256 before trusting any status here, and MUST verify audited_source_revision against the revision it is assessing. A missing artifact, a byte or digest mismatch, an absent status key, a status outside {OK, ERROR}, or a disagreement between a *_status key and its short-form twin resolves to ERROR - never to OK, and never by defaulting. The ERROR branch of the gate then fires and outranks BLOCK, WARN and PASS. This closes the failure mode in which a stale or forged all-OK ledger is paired with stale layer artifacts to suppress the ERROR branch.
provenance.binding_measured_at: immediately after the final write of every attested output and before the baseline and merged report were regenerated, so the digests describe the published bytes.
